description: List the platform animation library: ready clips (idle, walk, run, …) made once on a reference skeleton. generate_three_d with operation=library-animation puts them on any model rigged by operation=rig or auto-rig (input_task_id = the rig job). Each clip has its id, names, duration in seconds and the rig type it fits. Read-only and free.
name: list_animation_library
title: List animation library
